# infisical_app_connection_circleci (Resource)

Create and manage CircleCI App Connection

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_circleci" "example" {
  name        = "circleci-connection"
  description = "I am a test app connection"
  method      = "api-token"

  credentials = {
    api_token = "<your-circleci-api-token>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials for the CircleCI App Connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `method` (String) The method used to authenticate with CircleCI. Possible values are: api-token
- `name` (String) The name of the CircleCI App Connection to create. Must be slug-friendly

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the CircleCI App Connection.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to scope the app connection to. If not provided, the app connection will be scoped to the organization.

### Read-Only

- `credentials_hash` (String) The hash of the CircleCI App Connection credentials
- `id` (String) The ID of the app connection

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The CircleCI API token for authentication.

Optional:

- `host` (String) The CircleCI host to connect with, for self-hosted instances. (default: https://circleci.com)
